display_name: MiniMax H3 Reference to Video + Audio (4-step)
description: Generates a NEW scene with native audio from up to 4 reference images and an optional voice clip, with no pinned first frame. For recurring characters when you don't need an exact approved keyframe: testing staged a new scene from the prompt and spoke the line word-perfect, but art style drifted (darker, more animated-series). If the shot must match an approved keyframe, use qwen-edit-2511 + minimax-h3-i2v-fast instead. MiniMax H3 Ref2VA pruned int8 + 4-step turbo LoRA. ~4 min per 5s clip, ~44GB system RAM at peak: Needs at least 18 GB of swap active (the run refuses otherwise) and nothing else on the GPU; stop Chatterbox/ACE/Qwen-TTS first. 24fps, frames snap up to 5+17n (124=~5s, 243=~10s, 362=15s max). Prompt: style line, then SHOT lines describing motion, dialogue as (S1): <d>[English] words</d>, end with an 'Audio:' line. Audio loudness varies clip to clip (-31 to -16 dB): loudnorm before mixing. Long jobs return status 'running': poll get_job_result with wait_seconds.

prompt.description: Refer to references as <Picture 1>..<Picture 4> and the voice as <Audio 1>; style line + SHOT lines + (S1): <d>[English] words</d> + 'Audio:' line

ref_image_1.description: Reference image <Picture 1> (character, outfit, location; local path, uploaded automatically)

ref_image_2.description: Reference image <Picture 2> (character, outfit, location; local path, uploaded automatically), optional

ref_image_3.description: Reference image <Picture 3> (character, outfit, location; local path, uploaded automatically), optional

ref_image_4.description: Reference image <Picture 4> (character, outfit, location; local path, uploaded automatically), optional

ref_audio.description: Optional voice reference <Audio 1> (3-10s clean speech; local path, uploaded automatically)

width.description: Video width (multiple of 32), same aspect as the input

height.description: Video height (multiple of 32), same aspect as the input

frames.description: Frame count at 24fps, snapped up to 5+17n (124=~5s, 243=~10s, 362=15s)

steps.description: Sampling steps (4 matches the turbo LoRA)

ref_image_size.description: match: resize refs to the output canvas; max: keep refs at their larger native size
